findings: Records 139-142 remain rejected_legacy and must not be repopulated from historical PQ maps. The canonical record layer explicitly documents their removal after direct PQ evidence failed to corroborate the old attribution.
Record 143 is a real catalogue identity: "This is your true power?" by Gamma 1, acquired from PQ156.

Current catalogue evidence confirms the Just Guard trigger, -5% opponent-attack-strength effect for 10 seconds, and a second -5% damage-taken line for 10 seconds; the source's table/prose semantics are internally inconsistent, so the repository correctly preserves the discrepancy instead of inventing a normalized interpretation.
The Steam PQ guide independently lists Super Soul 143 as a basic reward of PQ156.
No changes to records 139-143 were necessary: 139-142 are intentionally rejected legacy records, while 143 is already partially verified and needs no unsupported normalization.
